exact: retrograde receptor complex, Golgi to ER
retrograde receptor complex, Golgi to endoplasmic reticulum
retrograde transporter complex, Golgi to endoplasmic reticulum

definition: Transporter complex that recognises, binds and returns endoplasmic reticulum (ER) resident proteins that have trafficked to Golgi compartments. Targets proteins lacking the HDEL motif recognised by COPI-coated vesicles.
label: retrograde transporter complex, Golgi to ER
